acceptance.criterion: 消息“在新会话中提问”有源标题、真实边界和可编辑问题预览；用户消息使用最近 assistant 祖先，说明此提问之前上下文，无祖先/无 entryId/忙态拒绝而不退化 tip fork。
acceptance.result: Owner transcript boundary, prior assistant ancestor, missing owner ID disabled in four locales; invalid ancestor rejected without tip fallback.

acceptance.criterion: 确认后以现有 fromLeafId Fork，子会话 composer 只预填问题且不发送；取消无副作用、失败不丢问题或源草稿、重复点击只创建一次。
acceptance.result: Preview edit/cancel; child draft only and chatSend=0; source draft retained; existing in-flight creation guard.

acceptance.criterion: 核对 ad77bf57c 的有意首轮发送行为；Handoff 主按钮明确为“创建并发送”，旧规格/测试标题/四语一致；发送失败保留已创建 child、来源和可恢复草稿。
acceptance.result: Create-and-send remains explicit; failure/unknown preserves child and draft; four-locale visible copy.

acceptance.criterion: Handoff 创建失败不切换；首轮效果未知先查询 owner 结果，不能自动重发或创建第二 child；来源告警、深度上限、gateway/active-run 拒绝均有可见反馈。
acceptance.result: Ancestry/depth/busy failures remain visible; unknown delivery reconciles and never silently re-sends.

acceptance.criterion: 会话内模型提出新会话建议只能进入同一预览确认；普通回复文字不能触发隐式创建，不新增第二派生关系或文本正则执行器。
acceptance.result: Plain model advice creates nothing; explicit existing Handoff menu opens the same editable preview; cancel changes neither sessions nor draft. Design section 94 expressly selects the existing menu when no typed suggestion action exists.

acceptance.criterion: Electron E2E 断言 Fork chatSend=0 与 Handoff 显式一次首发；取消、创建失败、发送失败/未知、重复提交、旧会话晚到响应均覆盖。
acceptance.result: Fork no-send, Handoff one first-send, cancellation, create/send failure, duplicate IDs and late cross-scope replies.

acceptance.criterion: 新Handoff在runtime SessionDerivation中有持久直接父级，重载来源不依赖Task Ledger推树；runtime失败不激活假child，部分成功可恢复，权限及generation屏障保持。
acceptance.result: Runtime confirms persistent direct parent and physical generation; real owner readback after restart; failure and generation fences retain recoverable operation.

acceptance.criterion: 创建响应丢失、首发超时、重复点击、A→B→A和进程重启均先回读持久操作与owner run/transcript/receipt；同一操作不再创建child，同一发送重试复用key。无可证明结果则保持unknown，不盲重发或声称exactly-once。
acceptance.result: Lost creation acknowledgement, unknown first-send, A/B navigation and two process restarts reuse child/send key; transcript identity resolves success, unproved delivery remains unknown.

acceptance.criterion: 新增owner单测及Electron中断/重启恢复断言；contract、comms replay/compare和窄spec验收通过后才宣称完成。
acceptance.result: Required owner, Electron restart and communication/spec gates read back from disk.

acceptance.criterion: Fork child默认仅有关联/只读职责，写前经A4重新准入；handoff关联与generation换代可对账，旧执行权不可继续用。
acceptance.result: Fork child retains TaskRefs without coordinator/write authority; Handoff drains old scope and uses runtime-confirmed generation.

acceptance.criterion: 同逻辑操作重试复用持久key；同payload的新合法意图可单独创建，key不只由payload hash派生。
acceptance.result: Two legitimate operation IDs with identical payload create separate children; each original operation reuses its own child and first-send key.

evidenceLevels.realOwner: u3-intent-e2e, u3-question-preview4, u3-owner-restart2 and u3-derivation-current launch Electron/Main/Gateway with real local state and a local scripted model. Missing message ID is an explicitly modified Host read projection.
evidenceLevels.hostFixture: Legacy Fork/Handoff rejection and late-response tests use Host fixture injection. Unit tests use the production Main owner/persistence with Gateway fixtures.
evidenceLevels.fault: Real restart test loses a completed creation response and fails acknowledgement persistence after a real send; it then reads the exact persisted transcript identity. UI scope tests hold the old response while navigation changes.

inheritance: Product bytes remain those built and tested at c6a439a52. Later changes correct the real generation test and prefer PowerShell 7 in the existing test-only process cleanup helper. The 112 product unit cases plus two real Windows process identity cases total 114; the current test type/spec gates are separate. The last source commit only restores LF endings, verified by an empty ignore-space-at-eol diff. Exact tested-source deltas are retained above.
